items.title: TikTok: posts from 13-14 Nov have vanished
items.body: Posts from 13-14 Nov no longer show in TikTok Studio (14 logged as removed; who or why is not recorded). Switch on 'Include removed' to see the ones with an old snapshot.

items.title: TikTok 7-day reach dropped
items.body: 7-day views went from 1.3K (14 Nov) to 132 (22 Nov). Cause not proven.

items.title: Twitch copyright-audio warning, 22 Nov (no strike)
items.body: Twitch muted GTA radio songs (Overmono 'Welcome to Leonida' twice, Booty Luv 'Shine') in 3 VODs, deleted clips cut from them, and turned Always Publish VODs off. No strike was issued.
